prompt: Create a soft pastel anime close-up portrait of a cute chibi-style girl with bubblegum pink hair in fluffy twin tails, large sleepy blue eyes, a tiny pouting mouth, and heavy rosy blush across both cheeks. Add exactly 1 pale yellow star hair clip on the right side of her hair, exactly 1 small white kitten with pink ears sleeping on top of her head, and exactly 2 glowing yellow sparkle stars floating to the left of her head. Use a warm indoor background with soft brown and cream tones, shallow depth of field, gentle bloom, glossy highlights on the hair and eyes, delicate line art, rounded proportions, kawaii Japanese MV-thumbnail aesthetic, square 1:1 composition, cropped close around the face and upper shoulders. Keep the mood sweet, sleepy, innocent, and pastel; no hard shadows, no realistic rendering, no extra characters, no readable text or watermark.
